Not a relaxing stay - Clean and well-equipped apartment, good view, air conditioning The apartment is on a very busy road, so it can be quite noisy, but the biggest issue was the noise from inside the building. On our first night, we were woken up at 12:30am by what sounded like a party upstairs, with lots of people stomping around. This continued through the night, we were woken again at 3am and 6am, and it felt like the ceilings were so thin that every step was directly above us. We barely slept. We reported it to reception, and while the night porter did intervene and management said they contacted the guests, the noise continued throughout the stay, constant stomping, chairs scraping, and doors slamming, even at 5 in the morning. Unfortunately, nothing further was done. We weren’t offered a room change, and were just told to report it again if another party happened, which wasn’t very reassuring given how disruptive it was. I tried ear plugs as I needed to sleep for my busy planned days ahead but I could still hear my above neighbours at 5am talking loudly, stomping and moving chairs (cheers for that!) I believe reception should have moved them from the start of the trip as we were unable to feel relaxed from day 1 because of the constant noise. The ceilings are SO thin and apparently no-one sleeps in the apartment block, they just stomp around all night! For the price (over £1000), we really expected a good night’s sleep, and that just wasn’t the case. It honestly felt like someone was stomping on us most of the time. The beds are also quite uncomfortable and hard. Everything is about 30-60 minute walk away so quite far away.

We dropped our shopping cart, rushed back to pack our things, and ran to the reception again. The management and the exhausting check-in process deserve a 1/10.

lastNeg.txt: - ⭐ One Star Only Because Zero Stars Isn’t an Option Unfortunately, our experience at Hostemplo Sagrada Familia was extremely disappointing. The only positive thing I can say is that the staff members we communicated with were friendly and polite. Beyond that, this stay was nothing like what we expected based on the listing and photographs. The room we received was not as represented in the pictures. The advertised room looked considerably more comfortable and functional. What we actually received was extremely cramped, with very little usable space. The “double bed” was actually two single beds pushed together. Even worse, the air-conditioning unit located inside the room continually dripped water, which is unacceptable, particularly during the summer when air conditioning is essential. Another major disappointment was the building itself. The exterior was covered in scaffolding because of ongoing renovations, with workers drilling into the walls during the day. After spending the day exploring Barcelona, coming back to rest while construction work was taking place directly outside was extremely frustrating. None of this matched the experience we believed we were Reception was non existing at the building. I would not stay here again, I cannot recommend it, and I sincerely hope we are able to obtain a refund for an experience that was so different from what was represented when we booked.
